residual_risks.title: Reference-device resource qualification remains a release obligation
residual_risks.detail: The output writer enforces table-position and estimated serialized-byte limits, but those estimates are not a peak-heap cap while evaluated rows, worksheet objects, shared strings, XML and compressed bytes coexist. The reviewed decision explicitly records this limit; reference-laptop qualification remains U13. No runtime measurements were executed in this review.
evidence: src/formats/xlsx-export.ts:13-14,69-89: 2 million table-position and 100 MiB serialization-estimate guards.
docs/decisions/excel-fidelity.md: Limits and remaining obligations and U10 value-only writer sections explicitly distinguish serialized budgets from process/heap bounds.

learnings.title: Qualify Excel archives before flattening cells
learnings.note: Known Pattern: preserve interpretation provenance, preflight actual archive expansion and package routing before SheetJS, and qualify the integrated worker/output XML. The reviewed implementation follows these boundaries; no violating rule or concrete missing test was established.
